trigger: a hive is removed and reloaded while the HKEY_USERS listing is read: walks {A,B}, {A}, {A,B}
classification_rationale: the listing is documented as accepted only when stable, but the middle walk was returned on the strength of the stamps around it, so {A} was certified complete
summary: stable_walk no longer takes a separate stamp: a list is accepted only when two consecutive walks return the same names (sorted), a failed walk is returned as it is, and a list that never agrees reports unstable after four walks. The walks {A,B},{A},{A,B} are a pure regression case that never certifies {A}.

policy_floor: CLAUDE.md Agent team & governance, pipeline gate 1: Change Summary + Resource Ledger; a C++ change commits a governance.d fragment
trigger: a C++ diff with no governance.d fragment, and row 10 of echo-registry-offline-hives.oLh7Kq.resource-ledger.md still saying the sweep is one attempt and that enumerate_hku_subkeys has no error channel
classification_rationale: the required Resource Ledger fragment for the change was missing and the earlier ledger's row no longer matched the code
summary: 7035-hku-enumeration-error-channel.mqjpxU.resource-ledger.md supersedes row 10 and records the new latch, the 2 to 4 walks per listing and the accepted residuals; the earlier run's ledger is left as recorded.

trigger: the start-up sweep cannot list HKEY_USERS on a host with no logged-off profile
classification_rationale: the sweep result carried a bool, so the first failure was silent and no log line named the cause
summary: HiveSweepResult carries listing_error (the cause) and run_pending_hive_sweep logs one hku_list_incomplete warning per failed listing, saying whether a retry is left.

trigger: a caller drops its hku.error check
classification_rationale: only the Echo sweep's refusal was pinned; the seven other callers are Windows-only shells with no Win32 in the unit suites
summary: tests/test_hku_listing_pin_lexical.py pins each caller: the call count, hku.error.empty() before the first hku.names, and the hku_list_incomplete token, with mutation self-tests and a scan for an unlisted caller.
